name: Hammer Vigil
design_intent:
TRIALS SURVIVE proof course (v7_trials_challenge_types.md §2.2, owner example t_hammer_vigil). Parked on ONE wide trampoline pad under a LETHAL spinning_hammer that sweeps the pad on a readable rhythm; survive the timer by riding the CLEAR BEAT -- the blade dwells off each side of the pad (a full-pad safe window ~1.5s) and sweeps across it (~1s each way) where only the trailing side is safe. A death (blade contact OR a void fall) RESETS the survival clock to 0 and ticks the death counter -- a RETRY, not a +2s penalty (that is the novel SURVIVE scoring). Clean (0 deaths) = gold.

PILLAR-2 / S-CAMP: the blade's head passes over EVERY x on the pad each half-sweep, so there is NO static tile you can idle out the whole timer on -- the safe spot moves each beat, forcing constant motion (dodge to the trailing side, or boost-hop the pass).

MOTION vs current Tuning: pivot (940,340) + arm_len 640 => head at bottom-of-arc y~980 (40px over the pad top 1020) so a center-standing player is struck as the blade crosses center; at the pad edges the blade rides ~150px higher, opening the trailing-side refuge. period 5.0s, dwell_frac 0.32 => two ~1.5s full-clear dwells + two ~1.0s sweeps per revolution. arc_deg 140 keeps the apexes (x ~= 940 +/- 601) well off the 840px-wide pad (edges 520 / 1360). A void below rings out a flung/fallen player. NO Tuning constant is touched -- the hammer kills via the existing kill(&"ring_out") pipeline.

SURVIVE (proof value 12s; owner headline ~20 is a level-design knob -- the medal is by DEATHS, not time, so the target length does not change the system). medal_survive (max deaths): gold 0 (clean), silver 1, bronze 5.
